# Promptok videókhoz és képekhez Jaid bemutató honlaphoz

Az alábbiakban kész, másolható promptokat kapsz videókhoz és képekhez, hogy professzionálisan mutasd be a Jaid-et egy landing oldalon. Mindegyik prompt platformfüggetlen, de jelzem, ha különösen jól működik Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, DALL·E vagy Runway/Kaiber/HeyGen irányban.

## Hero szekció

- Kép (hero background, letisztult, tech):
  “Futuristic minimal landing page hero image, abstract neural network mesh with soft gradients (indigo–teal), subtle depth of field, glowing node connections, clean white negative space for headline, premium SaaS aesthetic, 16:9, ultra-detailed, photoreal, soft light”

- Kép (Jaid logóval, kész termék-hangulat):
  “3D glass morphic logo orb with ‘Jaid’ text in sleek sans-serif, floating over blurred dashboard UI panels, subtle reflections, premium fintech/AI brand feel, soft glow, high contrast, studio lighting, 4K”

- Rövid hero videó (5–8 mp, loopolható):
  “Loopable 6-second cinematic UI montage of an AI dashboard: animations of nodes connecting, data streams flowing, charts animating in, smooth camera push-in, minimal color palette (indigo/teal/white), seamless loop, no text”

## Termékdemó és UI

- Kép (dashboard hero):
  “Clean AI platform dashboard UI mockup: left sidebar nav, main workspace with cards (metrics, charts, jobs), subtle glassmorphism, legible layout, empty states, no real brand names, high-res, front-on perspective”

- Kép (workflow builder):
  “Visual workflow editor with nodes and edges, draggable blocks labeled ‘Input’, ‘Transform’, ‘Validate’, ‘Deploy’, modern UI, crisp lines, soft shadows, neutral background, 3D isometric angle, 4K”

- Kép (model monitoring):
  “Model monitoring panel showing latency, accuracy, drift charts, light theme, enterprise-grade design, accessible typography, subtle grid, realistic but generic data, front view, product-shot lighting”

- Videó (15–20 mp, demó-montázs):
  “Product demo montage: user clicks ‘Create pipeline’, drags nodes, runs job, sees results update in charts, clean transitions, cursor highlights, macro shots of UI, branded color accents (indigo/teal), no text overlay, 1080p”

## Use case blokkok

- Kép (Customer Support / Copilot):
  “AI assistant chat UI embedded in a web app, suggests answers, highlights knowledge sources, neat bubbles, minimal icons, soft shadows, trustful tone, grayscale base + accent color”

- Kép (Data validation / compliance):
  “Compliance dashboard: validation checks, pass/fail badges, audit trail timeline, secure lock icon motif, clean enterprise UI style, neutral palette”

- Kép (Automation / orchestration):
  “Automation timeline with trigger→actions steps, success ticks, schedule calendar popover, modern SaaS aesthetics, isometric composition”

## Tech/Architecture

- Kép (architektúra diagram):
  “High-level system architecture diagram: client → API → services → models → storage, modular boxes, arrows, clean legend, consistent iconography, white background, brand colors for emphasis, export-ready vector aesthetic”

- Kép (security & governance):
  “Abstract shield over data streams, lattice pattern, subtle lock motif, premium tech illustration, depth via gradients, minimalism, editorial style”

- Kép (scalability/szerver):
  “Server racks stylized as glowing blocks, network lines pulzálnak, dark background, neon indigo/teal accents, cinematic contrast, 3D render look”

## Social proof és logósor

- Kép (ügyfél-logo sáv):
  “Row of grayscale placeholder logos on white background, equal spacing, subtle shadows, premium B2B SaaS feel, export as transparent PNG”

- Kép (testimonial kártya):
  “Testimonial card UI: avatar placeholder, name, title, company, star rating, quote section, clean spacing, light theme, ready-to-export module”

## CTA és pricing

- Kép (CTA blokkok):
  “Call-to-action section UI with ‘Start free trial’ button, two feature bullets, abstract gradient background ribbon, strong contrast, above-the-fold quality”

- Kép (pricing táblázat):
  “Pricing grid with three columns (Starter, Pro, Enterprise), toggle monthly/annual, primary button, checkmarks for features, clear hierarchy, accessibility contrast, no real numbers”

## Blog/Docs

- Kép (blog hero illusztráció):
  “Abstract AI brain made of nodes and lines, editorial illustration style, soft gradients, spacious composition for blog title overlay, 16:9”

- Kép (docs/SDK):
  “Code editor dark theme mockup with sample SDK snippet, syntax highlighting, comments, no real API keys, clean margins, developer aesthetic”

## Jaid brand és stílus irányelvek (opcionális prompt a konzisztenciához)

- Stílus:
  “Unified brand system: indigo (#3F37C9) and teal (#14B8A6) accents on white/very-light-gray, soft gradients, subtle glassmorphism, rounded-8px, shadow-2 for elevation, accessible typographic scale (Inter/SF/Geist), generous whitespace, ‘calm premium AI’ mood”

- Ikonok/illusztrációk:
  “Line icons with 2px stroke, rounded ends, minimal detail, consistent grid, fill accents only for emphasis, no text”

## Generatív AI eszköztippek

- Midjourney: használj aspect ratio-t (pl. --ar 16:9), quality-t (--q 2), és style-t (--style raw) a UI-hűséghez.
- Stable Diffusion/SDXL: ControlNet (reference scribble vagy layout) UI-wireframe alapján pontos elrendezéshez; inpainting UI állapot-váltásokhoz.
- DALL·E: jó a tiszta illusztrációkhoz és hero képekhez.
- Runway/Kaiber: UI motion montázsok, loopolható gradient animok.
- Luma/HeyGen: narrált explainerekhez, ha voiceover kell.

## Szöveg a képekre/videókra (ha overlay-t tervezel)

- Headline példák:
  - “Build, validate, and ship AI workflows — fast”
  - “Meet Jaid: Your AI copilot for data, automation, and operations”
- Subhead:
  - “From idea to production in minutes. Visual pipelines, guardrails, and observability included.”
- CTA:
  - “Start free trial”
  - “Book a demo”

## Gyors prompt sablon (cserélhető változókkal)

“Create a [type: hero image | dashboard mockup | workflow animation] for ‘Jaid’, a premium AI platform. Style: minimal, modern SaaS, brand colors (indigo/teal on white), subtle gradients, glassmorphism accents, clean typography space, export at [resolution]. Focus on [focus: nodes & edges | monitoring charts | compliance panel]. No real brand names, no lorem ipsum, no watermark.”

Ha szeretnél, megadom ugyanezeket konkrét Midjourney/SDXL paraméterezett formában is, vagy készítek promptokat magyar UI szöveggel a mockupokhoz.
